arxiv-2209-05011.title: Orthogonal Time Frequency Space Modulation – Part I: Fundamentals and Challenges Ahead Thanks: Z. Wei is with the School of Mathematics and Statistics, Xi’an Jiaotong University, Xi’an 710049, China (e-mail: zhiqiang.wei@xjtu.edu.au). Thanks: S. Li was with the School of Electrical Engineering and T
arxiv-2209-05011.creator: Zhiqiang Wei, Shuangyang Li, Weijie Yuan, Robert Schober, and Giuseppe Caire
arxiv-2209-05011.description: Abstract This letter is the first part of a three-part tutorial on orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) modulation, which is a promising candidate waveform for future wireless networks. This letter introduces and compares two popular implementations of OTFS modulation, namely the symplectic finite Fourier transform (SFFT)- and discrete Zak transform (DZT)-based architectures.

arxiv-2209-11546.title: Solvent quality dependent osmotic pressure of polymer solutions in two dimensions
arxiv-2209-11546.creator: Lei Liu, Changbong Hyeon
arxiv-2209-11546.description: Abstract Confined in two dimensional planes, polymer chains comprising dense monolayer solution are segregated from each other due to topological interaction. Although the segregation is inherent in two dimensions (2D), the solution may display different properties depending on the solvent quality.

arxiv-2305-00400.title: On LinDistFlow Model Congestion Pricing: Bounding the Changes in Power Tariffs
arxiv-2305-00400.creator: Shourya Bose, Kejun Chen, and Yu Zhang
arxiv-2305-00400.description: Abstract The optimal power flow (OPF) problem is an important mathematical program that aims at obtaining the best operating point of an electric power grid. The optimization problem typically minimizes the total generation cost subject to certain physical constraints of the system.

arxiv-2306-13461.title: Understanding quantum machine learning also requires rethinking generalization
arxiv-2306-13461.creator: Elies Gil-Fuster, Jens Eisert, Carlos Bravo-Prieto
arxiv-2306-13461.description: Abstract Quantum machine learning models have shown successful generalization performance even when trained with few data. In this work, through systematic randomization experiments, we show that traditional approaches to understanding generalization fail to explain the behavior of such quantum models. Our experiments reveal that state-of-the-art quantum neural networks accurately fit random states and random labeling of training data.

arxiv-2507-19635.title: Efficient and Scalable Agentic AI with Heterogeneous Systems
arxiv-2507-19635.creator: Zain Asgar, Michelle Nguyen, Sachin Katti
arxiv-2507-19635.description: Abstract AI agents are emerging as a dominant workload in a wide range of applications, promising to be the vehicle that delivers the promised benefits of AI to enterprises and consumers. Unlike conventional software or static inference, agentic workloads are dynamic and structurally complex.

arxiv-2602-05081.title: Gabor Fields: Orientation-Selective Level-of-Detail for Volume Rendering
arxiv-2602-05081.creator: Jorge Condor, Nicolai Hermann, Mehmet Ata Yurtsever, Piotr Didyk
arxiv-2602-05081.description: Abstract . Gaussian-based representations have enabled efficient physically-based volume rendering at a fraction of the memory cost of regular, discrete, voxel-based distributions. However, several remaining issues hamper their widespread use. One of the advantages of classic voxel grids is the ease of constructing hierarchical representations by either storing volumetric mipmaps or selectively pruning branches of an already hierarchical voxel grid.

pmc-10742470.title: Dual-Specificity Phosphatase 6 Deficiency Attenuates Arterial-Injury-Induced Intimal Hyperplasia in Mice
pmc-10742470.creator: Candra D Hamdin, Meng-Ling Wu, Chen-Mei Chen, Yen-Chun Ho, Wei-Cheng Jiang, Pei-Yu Gung, Hua-Hui Ho, Huai-Chia Chuang, Tse-Hua Tan, Shaw-Fang Yet, Alexander N Orekhov, Igor A Sobenin, Evgeny E Bezsonov
pmc-10742470.description: In response to injury, vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMCs) of the arterial wall dedifferentiate into a proliferative and migratory phenotype, leading to intimal hyperplasia. The ERK1/2 pathway participates in cellular proliferation and migration, while dual-specificity phosphatase 6 (DUSP6, also named MKP3) can dephosphorylate activated ERK1/2.

pmc-11355822.title: Superior Capsular Reconstruction Using an Acellular Dermal Xenograft or Allograft Improves Shoulder Function but Is Associated with a High Graft Failure Rate
pmc-11355822.creator: Maximilian Hinz, Lorenz Fritsch, Hannes Degenhardt, Marco-Christopher Rupp, Lucca Lacheta, Lukas N Muench, Andrea Achtnich, Sebastian Siebenlist, Bastian Scheiderer, Nicholas David Clement
pmc-11355822.description: Objectives: The purpose of the present study was to evaluate clinical and functional outcomes, graft integrity rate and progression of osteoarthritis after superior capsular reconstruction (SCR) at short-term follow-up. Methods: Consecutive patients that underwent SCR using an acellular dermal xeno- or allograft between May 2018 and June 2020 for the treatment of irreparable posterosuperior rotator cuff tears were included.

pmc-11647930.title: Myelodysplastic syndromes among atomic bomb survivors in Nagasaki: similarities to and differences from de novo and therapy-related cases
pmc-11647930.creator: Koji Ando, Yasushi Miyazaki
pmc-11647930.description: Epidemiological studies for atomic bomb (A-bomb) survivors clearly demonstrated that A-bomb radiation increased the risk of hematological neoplasms, such as acute and chronic leukemia, and myelodysplastic syndromes (MDS) among survivors. Several studies on MDS among survivors investigated its characteristics, and it seems that MDS among survivors has different features from those seen in de novo MDS and therapy-related MDS.

pmc-12490975.title: Robust machine-learning based prognostic index using fatty acid metabolism genes predicts prognosis and therapy responses in glioblastoma
pmc-12490975.creator: Erjie Zhao, Zihan Wang, Liya Tang, Longxiu Zhang, Liuguijie He, Mengdie Li, Xin Ge, Zhumei Shi, Xu Qian, Risheng Cao
pmc-12490975.description: Background: Glioblastoma (GBM) is the most prevalent and aggressive type of primary brain tumor in adults. Fatty acid metabolism plays a crucial role in promoting tumorigenesis, disease progression, and therapeutic resistance through the regulation of lipid synthesis, storage, and catabolism. However, its potential for predicting both prognosis and treatment response in glioblastoma is unexplored.

pmc-12592444.title: A chromosome-level genome assembly of the dried fruit mite Carpoglyphus lactis
pmc-12592444.creator: Lang Liang, Hu-Die He, Dao-Chao Jin, Tian-Ci Yi
pmc-12592444.description: Carpoglyphus lactis is a globally distributed stored-product pest mite that inflicts substantial damage on dried fruits, grains, and other preserved commodities. However, the absence of high-quality genomic resources has long constrained insights into its biology and evolutionary characteristics. In this study, we report a chromosome-level genome assembly for C.

pmc-12754264.title: Interaction Effect of Depression and Hypertension on Nephrotoxicity Among Persons Living With HIV: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-12754264.creator: John Tetteh, Naana Agyeman, Swithin M. Swaray, Kwasi Torpey, Elijah Paintsil, Alfred Edwin Yawson, Duah Dwomoh
pmc-12754264.description: BackgroundThe goal of antiretroviral therapy will not be achieved without addressing Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV) comorbidities, including depression, hypertension, and nephrotoxicity among people living with HIV (PLWH). This study was conducted to assess the interaction effect of depression and hypertension on nephrotoxicity among PLWH.MethodsThe study employed a cross‐sectional study design. Data were collected from May to June 2022.

pmc-13224706.title: The role of protein palmitoylation in disease pathogenesis and therapeutic innovation
pmc-13224706.creator: Xinyue Lin, Jinshan Xing, Keran Jia, Shuang Liu, Yuzhou Liu, Yingjiang Gu, Kai Guo, Jingyan Yi
pmc-13224706.description: BackgroundProtein palmitoylation is a significant post-translational modification that influences protein stability, localization, and signaling through the addition of palmitoyl groups to cysteine, serine/threonine, or lysine residues. It is facilitated by palmitoyltransferases (e.g. zDHHC family) and reversed by depalmitoylases such as APT1/2. Dysregulation of this modification has been associated with several diseases, including diabetes and cancer.

pmc-13318074.title: Fenbendazole-Associated Drug-Induced Liver Injury with Concomitant Use of Tauroursodeoxycholic Acid
pmc-13318074.creator: Alexander Satinsky, Nancy Mayer, Charles Swanson, Brian Sasso
pmc-13318074.description: Influenced by the internet and social media, a growing number of individuals are taking hepatotoxic amounts of prescription and nonprescription drugs leading to drug-induced liver injuries (DILIs). We present a case of fenbendazole-associated DILI with concomitant use of tauroursodeoxycholic acid as an intended hepatoprotective agent.

pmc-13333099.title: Infant Botulism in Costa Rica: A Case Report Featuring Electrodiagnostic Studies
pmc-13333099.creator: Anthony Hong, Ana B Santos, Daniela Poveda, Alfonso Gutiérrez-Mata, Adriana Ulate-Campos
pmc-13333099.description: Infant botulism (IB) is a life-threatening neuroparalytic condition caused by a neurotoxin produced by Clostridium botulinum (C. botulinum). We present the case of a four-month-old Costa Rican female who was hospitalized with poor sucking, feeding difficulties, constipation, hypotonia, and respiratory failure. Clinical history, physical examination findings, and electrodiagnostic studies strongly suggested IB.

pmc-13571846.title: Diagnostic Reasoning in General Internal Medicine Consultations: A Text Mining Analysis of Consultation Requests
pmc-13571846.creator: Ren Kawamura, Yukinori Harada, Taro Shimizu
pmc-13571846.description: BackgroundDiagnostic reasoning is often difficult to evaluate because it is largely internal, and linguistic features associated with consultation quality remain poorly understood. Consultation requests may provide a useful window into real‐time diagnostic thinking. We used text mining to examine how language in consultation requests reflects diagnostic reasoning in general internal medicine.
